# Jackson Injury Firm

> Jackson Injury Firm is a Personal injury attorney serving Fayetteville, Georgia. Jackson Injury Firm is a personal injury law firm in Fayetteville, Georgia, serving clients across South Metro Atlanta and throughout the state. Led by attorney Jacob Jackson, the firm represents people injured in car, truck and motorcycle collisions, slip and falls, dog attacks
